description:
A correctness defect independent of HTR-10, surfaced by the HTR-10 capability audit. Raised here because the scoping doc flags it as warranting its own bead.

THE DEFECT: crates/boon-lay/.../release_fraction_crp_6_case_1a_1b.rs:50 wraps its assertion against the published reference range in catch_unwind and DISCARDS the result, then asserts the code own output against a value that lies OUTSIDE that reference range. The test passes while the model disagrees with the reference it names in its own filename.

This is worse than having no test: it reads as validation evidence while providing none. Under VERIFICATION_AND_VALIDATION.md the TRISO release model must be treated as UNVALIDATED until this is fixed.

FIX: remove the catch_unwind, assert against the published reference range, and let it fail if the model disagrees. Then either fix the model or record the disagreement honestly as a known limitation with the measured discrepancy. Do not adjust the reference to match the code.
title: boon-lay DEFECT: TRISO release verification test asserts against itself, not the reference
